title: viya-cli workflow
description: Project-level workflow plan for viya-cli workflow run. Top-level steps run serially; one nested array runs its child work items in parallel.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema.

name.description: Human-friendly workflow name and Compute session name.

maxParallel.description: Maximum number of parallel work items to run inside a nested array.

contextId.description: Default Compute context ID for this project workflow.

contextName.description: Default Compute context name for this project workflow.

includeOutput.description: Whether to retrieve Compute log/listing text for work items.

keepSession.description: Keep the Compute session after the workflow completes.

id.description: Optional stable identifier. Used as the name when name is absent.

name.description: Human-friendly work item name and Compute job name.

file.description: SAS file path relative to the workflow file directory.

work.description: Alias for file, useful for compact workflow files.

code.description: Inline SAS code to prepend before the file body, or to run by itself when no file is set.

log.description: Optional path for saving this job's Compute log text.

listing.description: Optional path for saving this job's listing text.

variables.description: Non-secret string variables passed to Compute job variables and SAS macro variables.
